openUiAnatomy: no published Open UI dropdown-menu anatomy — union of shadcn's canonical 'dropdown-menu' (a thin data-slot wrapper around the external, unvendored `radix-ui` package's DropdownMenu primitive), Salt's `menu-button` (a real `Button` trigger composed with `cascading-menu`, itself a separate, data-driven implementation from `core/menu`), and M3's real, live `menu`/`menu-item`/`sub-menu` component family plus the `standard-menu-button` token file for the trigger. See DROPDOWN-MENU-MATRIX.md §0 for the full three-way relationship and the scope decisions (checkbox/radio item variants excluded — no cross-system equivalent exists to extract; trigger IN scope as this component's own part, because all three systems answer its styling question differently, including shadcn's real, sourced ABSENCE of any owned trigger style).

behavior.pattern: A trigger opens a floating popup listing ACTION items (not a value-setter, contrast with `select`). Items may be plain actions or submenu triggers that open a nested popup one level deep. Keyboard: ArrowUp/Down moves the active item, Home/End jump to the first/last, Enter/Space activates and closes the whole stack, Escape/outside-click dismisses, ArrowRight opens a submenu (also openable by hover after a short delay) and ArrowLeft closes it and returns focus to its own trigger item. Typeahead (jump to the item whose label starts with the typed character) is a first-class but NOT universal behaviour — real and explicit in M3, real and explicit in shadcn's external package (well-documented convention, not independently inspectable here), CONFIRMED ABSENT in Salt (grepped, no typeahead code anywhere in core/menu or lab/cascading-menu).
behavior.chassis: skeleton/dropdown-menu.tsx — written from the template's part union; inherits from no design system. Submenu nesting is modelled to ONE level (both real systems this pipeline can inspect — Salt, M3 — support arbitrary depth via recursion, but a validation skeleton needs only one level to exercise every real behaviour: ArrowRight-open, hover-open-with-delay, ArrowLeft-close, non-overlapping side-by-side popup geometry). A declared, reasonable simplification, not a silent one — see DROPDOWN-MENU-MATRIX.md.
